ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure; on the left is a bicyclic alkene skeleton containing one C=C double bond; the upper right of this skeleton is connected to an acyl/amide-like fragment, showing C=O and connection to N; the N on the right is further connected to an O-SO2-Ph group; at the lower left there is also a carbonyl amide fragment, connected to an N bearing H and further connected to Ar. The figure also has curved arrows and negative-charge markings, but the problem requires ignoring arrows and not counting hydrogen-related bonds. Reasoning: Count strictly by fragments. 1) The left bicyclic alkene skeleton contributes 10 bond units, in which C=C is counted as 2 bond units. 2) The upper acyl/amide part contributes 4 bond units: ring-C single bond 1, C=O double bond 2, C-N single bond 1, totaling 4. 3) The lower amide/anilide-like part contributes 5 bond units: ring-C single bond 1, C=O double bond 2, C-N single bond 1, N-Ar single bond 1; N-H is not counted, totaling 5. 4) The N-O-SO2-Ph group contributes 7 bond units: N-O single bond 1, O-S single bond 1, two S=O double bonds totaling 4, S-Ph single bond 1, totaling 7. 5) The Ph phenyl abbreviation contributes 6 C-C ring bond units. The total is 10 + 4 + 5 + 7 + 6 = 32.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: Count by fragments: (1) left bicyclic alkene skeleton contributes 10 bond units, counting its one C=C as two; (2) the upper acyl/amidic part contributes 4: ring-C, C=O as 2, and C-N; (3) the lower amide/anilide part contributes 5: ring-C, C=O as 2, C-N, and N-Ar, while excluding N-H; (4) the N-O-SO2-Ph group contributes 7: N-O, O-S, two S=O double bonds as 4, and S-Ph; (5) the phenyl abbreviation Ph contributes 6 C-C ring bonds. Sum 10+4+5+7+6 = 32.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧为含一个 C=C 双键的双环烯烃骨架；该骨架右上连有一个酰基/酰胺样片段，显示 C=O 和与 N 相连；右侧 N 再连到 O-SO2-Ph 基团；左下还有一个羰基酰胺片段，连到带 H 的 N，并进一步连到 Ar。图中还有弯箭头和负电荷标记，但题目要求忽略箭头，且不计入氢相关键。推理：严格按片段计数。1）左侧双环烯烃骨架贡献 10 个键单位，其中 C=C 按 2 个键单位计。2）上方酰基/酰胺部分贡献 4 个键单位：环-C 单键 1，C=O 双键 2，C-N 单键 1，共 4。3）下方酰胺/苯胺样部分贡献 5 个键单位：环-C 单键 1，C=O 双键 2，C-N 单键 1，N-Ar 单键 1；N-H 不计，共 5。4）N-O-SO2-Ph 基团贡献 7 个键单位：N-O 单键 1，O-S 单键 1，两个 S=O 双键共 4，S-Ph 单键 1，共 7。5）Ph 苯基缩写贡献 6 个 C-C 环键单位。总数为 10 + 4 + 5 + 7 + 6 = 32。
